title: No test checks that a personal-training booking hides the member's phone, fees and body numbers
what: The trainer week test reads bookings as the desk and as trainers, but never checks what each booking carries. A later change could add the member's phone or money to every booking and all tests would still pass.
expected: A test reads a booking as a trainer and as the desk and checks it holds only the name, time and trainer.
fix_line: Add a check that a booking carries no phone, fee or body numbers

title: The nightly test-gym clean-up is tested on one gym row only
what: The clean-up test deletes one test gym and checks the gym row and the log code. It never checks the 100-a-night limit, that the gym's members, check-ins and terms rows go too, or that the log carries no member names or phones.
expected: Tests prove the limit, that every row of a deleted test gym goes, and that the log names only gyms.
fix_line: Give the test gym members and terms rows, and many test gyms, and check all of it

title: The desk journey expects a question sent to the front desk, but the server refuses that
what: One front desk journey starts with a member question sent to "Gym admin". The database test proves such a question is refused; only feedback and complaints may go to "Gym admin". The journey describes something that can never happen, so its first step can never be tested.
expected: The journey and the server agree on who a question can go to.
fix_line: Change the journey to start with a feedback sent to the front desk

title: The refusal and done lines of Message your gym are never checked on a screen
what: The database test proves empty, too many, paused-gym, nameless-complaint and full-conversation messages are refused. No test shows the member or the owner the words for any of these, or the member's "marked this as done" and "Sent." lines.
expected: Each refusal and status line is checked once on the phone or in the admin app.
fix_line: Add phone and admin app checks for each refusal line

title: The paid-features lock switch is not tested on screen, offline, for the desk or for a member who left
what: Tests cover the switch's saved value and the app's lock rule. Nothing opens the Settings card as owner or desk, saves it with no internet, shows the desk the new value after the owner changes it, or checks a member who left and a locked member's own data.
expected: The card is checked for owner and desk, offline, and a locked member still sees all their own data.
fix_line: Add a screen test of the card for owner and desk, offline, and a locked member

title: No test sends a gym note to a phone whose first name does not match, or with another gym's id
what: The pop-up test covers a shared number, but never a list entry whose first name differs from the app member, and never hands the fee list an item with a wrong gym id. A note could reach the wrong person and the tests would pass.
expected: Tests prove no note is made for a name that does not match or a wrong gym id.
fix_line: Add a mismatched first name and a wrong gym id to the test

title: No test closes a member question after 14 days with no reply
what: The question tests answer, take back and refuse questions, but none ages a question past 14 days. Nothing proves it leaves "Waiting for your reply" or that "Closed with no reply after 14 days." appears.
expected: A test ages a question 14 days and checks it closes and shows the closed line.
fix_line: Add a test that ages a question and checks it closes

title: Find my gym's not-found, too-many and pass lines are never checked
what: The server test proves the search answers, but no test checks the member sees "We did not find your gym", the too-many-searches line, or "You train there on a pass."
expected: Each of these lines is checked once in the phone app.
fix_line: Add word checks for the not-found, too-many and pass lines
